product_title: Traditional Pearl Lotus Shubh Labh Hanging Pair with Golden Accents
product_description: Bring prosperity and traditional elegance to your home with this beautifully handcrafted Shubh Labh hanging pair. Featuring intricate white pearl embellishments, vibrant pink lotus motifs, auspicious red Shubh Labh detailing, and elegant golden accents, these decorative hangings create a festive and luxurious look. The circular design, delicate pearl tassels, and graceful finish make them perfect for decorating main doors, pooja rooms, temples, and festive entrances. Ideal for Diwali celebrations, weddings, housewarming ceremonies, and other auspicious occasions, this decorative pair adds a beautiful traditional touch to your home decor.
product_care_suggestion: Gently wipe with a soft, dry cloth to remove dust.
Keep away from water and moisture to protect the pearls and decorative materials.
Avoid direct sunlight for prolonged periods to maintain the vibrant pink and red colors.
Handle the pearl tassels carefully to prevent tangling or breakage.
Do not use harsh chemicals, detergents, or abrasive cleaning materials.
Store in a dry place inside a soft cloth bag or protective box when not in use.
Keep away from sharp objects to prevent scratches and damage to the decorative embellishments.
Hang securely and avoid pulling the hanging loops or tassels.
